marc:datafield.marc:subfield: The keris is a kind of Malay weapon believed to date back more then seven centuries. It is thought to have originated in the Malay Archipelago, and is found only there, in particular in Malaysia and Indonesia. The keris is regarded as a precious cultural heritage of the Malay race, having strong associations with heroism and mysticism, and figuring prominently in Malay legends and malay history. Until today tke keris has been, and remains a symbol of the sovereign power of Malay rulers, besides reflecting great refinement f craftsmanship.
